reviews.comment: This professor does not prepare you for the final paper or tests well. Throughout the course assignments were extremely easy as I maintained a high A. The final paper does not come with much instruction and he grades it extremely harshly. Luckily as an online class, I had the material at hand but have heard its hard to obtain when in person.

He talks really fast and doesn't go back over definitions and doesn't post the presentations so you can go back and study things. He only posts like half the readings actually needed. He cusses unnecessarily and thinks that he's funny when he actually isn't. I had a hard time trying to keep up in the class.

He sometimes spoke quickly and it was difficult to hear through his mask, but when asked to speak up he kindly did so. I found it easier to take chapter notes prior to lectures so that I could just listen during the lectures and add in additional notes. He is very kind and his tests were usually very straightforward

he is overall a really nice guy and wants the best for us and wants us to do well and learn. i feel bad but he just moves very quickly and its nearly impossible to take notes on everything unless you have 2+ people collaborating. there's four exams and none are cumulative. studying is A LOT bc theres sm material but it's all multiple choice so idrk
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy
